user_idea_text:
AI visibility for local businesses in London
Find out what AI assistants know about your business, how they describe your services, and whether they recommend you to potential customers.
How it works: A simple web app that monitors your visibility across AI platforms.

derived_market: The AI search optimization and visibility market focuses on managing how generative AI models, LLMs, and AI-powered search engines represent businesses to users. It encompasses the technical monitoring, auditing, and content strategy required to influence AI-generated recommendations, summaries, and business profiles.
desk_limits: We read what people said unprompted. We could not ask them the follow-up question.

anchored_pains.pain_title: Cannot establish a stable prompt-level visibility baseline
quotes: We've been using AIClicks to monitor how brands appear across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity, and that data helps validate whether those SEO efforts are translating into AI visibility rather than just assuming they are...
I've tested a few platforms, but I still spend a lot of time validating results manually across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.

anchored_pains.pain_title: Cannot keep business facts consistent across AI-retrieved sources
quotes: I'll run the same prompt across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini and get three completely different cited sources.

But when I started testing AI visibility (asking ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini about their category), the brand barely showed up, while a much smaller competitor with a *thinner* backlink profile kept getting cited.

related_pains.pain_title: Cannot compare recommendation share of voice across AI systems
Cannot keep local service and location data consistent across profiles

red_team_findings.claim: Ayzeo is a direct category incumbent overlapping the proposed local-business AI visibility monitor: its search result explicitly offers getting local businesses recommended by AI chatbots, monitoring “near me” prompts, validating LocalBusiness schema, and tracking AI visibility.

The buyer can access free alternatives in the same workflow: Ayzeo advertises a free analysis, Birdeye advertises a free AI visibility checker covering ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini, and Real Connection Media advertises a free AI visibility check.

The supplied evidence does not establish who pays, willingness to pay, or that scheduled compliant platform-interface checks solve the common case; the results show monitoring/checking and service offers but do not establish the proposed mechanism’s coverage, access, or conversion to paying customers.

top.name: PromptBaseline
top.one_liner: Measure whether an AI visibility change is real before acting, then trace unstable prompt claims to the public entity facts that may be causing the drift.

top.name: Answer Recovery Lab
top.one_liner: Turn unstable AI visibility into a testable engineering problem: show the exact journey by which an answer disappears, identify the smallest structural repair,

top.name: Citation Gap Triage
top.one_liner: Give brand reputation teams a prompt-level verdict that explains whether an AI recommendation omission is caused by missing third-party evidence or model sampli

top.name: ContextCut Test
top.one_liner: Show London service providers which page passages remain accurate, identifiable, and understandable when extracted alone—and exactly how to rewrite the passages

top.name: GEO Change Ledger
top.one_liner: Give marketers a permanent public URL proving exactly what GEO changed, when it changed, and what visibility movement followed.
